description: Search Herofold's finished landing pages, sections cut from those pages (type block), animated AI components (type motion) and AI dashboards (type chat). Plain language works for pages ("a calm dentist page in Dubai"), read the way herofold.dev's own search reads it. Filter by type (page, block, motion, chat), industry, region, category, plan (free or pro) and theme (light or dark). Results are grouped by type, each with its id, plan, page address and cover image. Call list_categories for the filter values.

category.description: Section category or group (hero, pricing, pricing-sections), component category, set or topic (thinking, essentials), or page type (saas, app-waitlist)

industry.description: Page industry key or name, for example health, finance, software (list_categories)

limit.description: Per kind. Default 5 when several kinds, 10 for one

offset.description: Skip this many results in each kind to see the next page; each group says its total

plan.description: free: everything opens through this server now

query.description: Plain words: what the business does, where it is, how it should look, or the part you need

region.description: Region, flavor or continent key, for example uae, japan, uk-experience, africa

theme.description: Only items with a light or a dark look, in every kind

type.description: Only these kinds. Leave out for all four, grouped

items.description: page, block (a page section), motion (an animated AI component or an AI platform screen) or chat (an AI dashboard)

name: search
title: Search the library
